citations.M1: 0143 goes out in a later release once items 2, 7, 8 and 16 are verified
citations.M2: add a dual-write/dual-read release first (write both columns, read `state` with fallback to `status`), and only switch to state-only after backfill is verified complete
citations.M3: every `get_order` on an unbackfilled row raises ValueError (500s) for the entire backfill duration
citations.M4: The CASE has no ELSE, so `PAID`, `canceled`, `complete` and the 149 NULLs (7,764 rows) map to NULL and stay NULL forever, which makes 0143's SET NOT NULL fail
citations.M5: each UPDATE removes rows from the `state IS NULL` set, so the next OFFSET jumps past unprocessed rows
citations.M6: The whole backfill runs in one transaction, holding row locks on every updated order for hours ... any crash rolls back everything (so "safe to re-run" means "start over"); commit per batch
citations.M7: `jobs/nightly_finance_export.py` reads `o.status` and filters `IN ('paid','shipped')`; the grep was limited to `app/`, so 0143 breaks Friday's 02:00 UTC Finance export
citations.M8: add a preflight in 0143 that asserts `count(*) WHERE state IS NULL = 0`
citations.M9: staging's "1055000 of 2104377" is this bug, not a stat
citations.M10: 0143's downgrade re-adds `status` as an empty column, so a rollback after step 4 leaves the old app reading NULL statuses
citations.M11: Prod runtime is at least 61M/2.1M × 11 min ≈ 5.5 h even before the quadratic OFFSET cost, so the backfill cannot fit "all in the Thursday window"
citations.M12: `ALTER COLUMN state SET NOT NULL` in 0143 scans all 61M rows under ACCESS EXCLUSIVE, blocking every read and write
